messages.author: 0f36a4d38f68e366
messages.subject: Re: can i use this package to analyse 2PlexTMT data?
parts:
Hi,

MSstatsTMT v1.2.7 will be available in Bioconductor in one or two days. It provides a global peptide normalization between channels and runs. It will remove technical bias between channels. But since your data doesn't have 'Norm' channel, local protein normalization with respect to normalization channels is unable to preform. Batch effect between two mixtures (plex) may be not completely removed.

For the error in MaxQtoMSstatsTMTFormat(), could you share your evidence file? If it is too large, you may upload the first 10000 rows of evidence file.

Best,
Ting
